item.text:
=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story architecture
summary:      Define application boundaries and the shared service scaffold.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     application modules
consumes:
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Establish the Python application structure and boundaries for configuration, persistence,
  CLI, and HTTP service modules. Keep database access behind the shipped persistence library.

## story database
summary:      Declare the rates store and its repository operations.
type:         foundational
kind:         migration
phase:        1
implements:   DATABASE.md
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        common.md, python.md, persistence.md, sqlite.md
provides:     rates repository
consumes:
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Declare the rates schema and repository operations required by initialization, loading, and
  API reads. Store published rates as text and support replacement by date and currency.

## story cli-entry
summary:      Establish the fxrates command entry point.
type:         foundational
kind:         integration
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Entry.md
stack:        common.md, python.md, cli.md
provides:     ./fxrates command dispatch
consumes:     application modules
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Create the root executable and command dispatch structure for init, load, fetch, and serve.
  Preserve the specified command arguments and exit-code contract.

## story ecb-001
summary:      Initialize the rates store.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Initialize.md
covers:       ECB-001
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md, cli.md, sqlite.md
provides:     fxrates init
consumes:     rates repository
depends:      architecture, database, cli-entry
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement initialization through the declared persistence boundary. Match the source behavior
  of creating an empty rates table and printing nothing.

## story ecb-002
summary:      Validate and atomically load ECB history CSV files.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Load.md
covers:       ECB-002
accepts:      st-003, st-008
context:      DATABASE.md, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv
context_roles: |
  sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv: asset
  sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv: asset
stack:        common.md, python.md, cli.md, sqlite.md
provides:     fxrates load
consumes:     rates repository
depends:      architecture, database, cli-entry
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Validate each input file completely before writing. Skip N/A values, preserve published rate
  text, replace matching date/currency records, and report counts from the loaded file.
  A rejected file must leave stored data unchanged.

## story ecb-003
summary:      Fetch and load ECB history archives.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Fetch.md
covers:       ECB-003
accepts:      st-009
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md, cli.md, sqlite.md
provides:     fxrates fetch
consumes:     fxrates load
depends:      architecture, database, cli-entry, ecb-002
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Download the ECB history archive, extract eurofxref-hist.csv, and pass it through the CSV
  loader behavior. Tests must stub the download and use no network.

## story api-001
summary:      Serve health and dataset statistics.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Service-Status.md
covers:       API-001
accepts:      st-004
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     GET /health, GET /stats
consumes:     rates repository
depends:      architecture, database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement health and database-derived publication statistics endpoints.

## story api-002
summary:      List currencies that have stored rates.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Currencies.md
covers:       API-002
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     GET /currencies
consumes:     rates repository
depends:      architecture, database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Return the ascending list of currencies with stored rates and EUR as the base.

## story api-003
summary:      Retrieve rates for an effective publication date.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Rates.md
covers:       API-003
accepts:      st-005
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     GET /rates/{date}, GET /rates/latest
consumes:     rates repository
depends:      architecture, database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Resolve requested dates to the latest publication on or before the date. Return 404 when no
  prior publication exists and include the requested date and stored rate text in successful
  responses.

## story conv-001
summary:      Convert an amount between currencies.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Conversion.md
covers:       CONV-001
accepts:      st-005, st-006
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     GET /convert
consumes:     rates repository
depends:      architecture, database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Resolve the effective publication date and calculate cross-rates and results with Decimal
  arithmetic and half-even rounding at the specified precisions.

## story hist-001
summary:      Retrieve bounded currency history and statistics.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-History.md
covers:       HIST-001
accepts:      st-006
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     GET /history/{code}
consumes:     rates repository
depends:      architecture, database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Return ascending publication points within optional inclusive bounds and compute exact
  minimum, maximum, and half-even six-decimal mean. Return empty statistics when no points exist
  and 404 for a currency with no stored rates.

## story ops-001
summary:      Run the HTTP service on loopback.
type:         service
kind:         integration
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Serve.md
covers:       OPS-001
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, cli.md
provides:     fxrates serve
consumes:     HTTP API
depends:      architecture, cli-entry, api-001, api-002, api-003, conv-001, hist-001
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Start the API with uvicorn on 127.0.0.1 using the requested port or default port 8000.
  Keep the server in the foreground and support clean SIGTERM shutdown.

## story ops-002
summary:      Report CLI usage and operational errors.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Errors.md
covers:       OPS-002
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md, cli.md
provides:     CLI error handling
consumes:     ./fxrates command dispatch
depends:      architecture, cli-entry, ecb-001, ecb-002, ecb-003, ops-001
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Apply the specified usage, operational, and rejected-file exit codes. Keep command failures'
  standard output empty and write one diagnostic line to standard error.

## story ops-003
summary:      Validate API request inputs and currency errors.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Errors.md
covers:       OPS-003
accepts:      st-007
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     API request validation
consumes:     HTTP API
depends:      architecture, database, api-003, conv-001, hist-001
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Return 422 for malformed dates, malformed amounts, and missing required query parameters.
  Return 404 for unknown currencies under the specified endpoint conditions.

## story ops-004
summary:      Verify the complete application test suite.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Verification.md
covers:       OPS-004
accepts:      st-001, st-002
context:      sources/run.sh, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv
context_roles: |
  sources/run.sh: context
  sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv: asset
  sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv: asset
  sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv: asset
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, cli.md, sqlite.md
provides:     complete project verification
consumes:     ./fxrates, HTTP API, bin/test.sh
depends:      architecture, database, cli-entry, ecb-001, ecb-002, ecb-003, api-001, api-002, api-003, conv-001, hist-001, ops-001, ops-002, ops-003
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Run the supplied grader and the project's complete automated suite as the terminal verification
  story. The supplied grader's exit status is the conformance verdict.
=== END ARTIFACT ===

        "label": "Wait without a timeout"
      }
    ],
    "system_choice": "10 seconds"
  }
]
